concept: Classic pin-pull rescue. Vertical chambers separated by golden pins. Hero (cute knight) at bottom, treasure pile + lava + water blobs above. Tapping a pin slides it out and physics particles (lava=orange, water=blue, gold=coins) fall. Lava + water => stone (steam puff). Win when gold coins reach hero and lava never touches him. 3 handcrafted levels chosen randomly. Juice: coins clink, hero cheers, steam hiss, lava burns hero into skeleton comedic lose.

hookEn: Only geniuses choose the right gates
hookJa: 天才だけが正しいゲートを選べる
concept: 3D runner (mini3d) seen from behind: crowd of little blue stickmen runs forward on a track; drag left/right to steer through pairs of gates (+10, x2, -20, /2). Crowd count shown on a flag. Red enemy crowds clash (counts subtract with particle burst). At the end, a giant boss with HP number; crowd must exceed it. Win if crowd > boss. Crowd rendered as many small low-poly figures clustered.

hookJa: 気持ちよすぎて止まらない
concept: Water sort puzzle: 5 glass tubes with 4 colored layers, 2 empty. Tap source then target to pour (animated tilt + stream). Top layer moves if target top matches or is empty. Win when every tube is single-color or empty. Generate solvable puzzle by random reverse moves from solved state (3 colors, easy). Juice: glug SFX, tube sparkle cork pop when complete.

hookJa: あなたは何段まで行ける？
concept: 3D isometric Stack game: a slab slides back and forth along x then z; tap to drop; overhang is sliced off and falls (tumbling piece). Perfect placement (within tolerance) triggers ripple ring and combo. Camera rises. Color gradient shifts per level. Win at 12 layers; lose when slab misses entirely.

hookEn: Can you get the red car out?
concept: Top-down rush-hour: 6x6 lot, cars 2-3 cells long, horizontal/vertical. Drag cars along their axis. Red car must exit right edge. Several hand-made easy levels. Cars have windows, headlights, honk SFX on collision. Exiting red car zooms away with dust.

hookEn: Draw ONE line. Save the dog.
concept: Player draws one line with finger (limited ink bar). On release the line becomes a solid shield; a beehive releases angry bees swarming toward the doge for 6 seconds. Bees bounce off line (simple collision with polyline). Doge survives => win (happy face), stung => puffed face lose. Cute shiba face vector.

ja: ロープを切ってアメを届けろ
hookJa: おなかペコペコなんです…
concept: Candy hangs from 2-3 ropes (verlet rope sim). Swipe to cut ropes. Candy swings and falls; collect stars optionally; must land in green monster's mouth at bottom. Monster eyes follow candy, chomps on catch. Levels randomized from 3 layouts.

ja: フルーツ合体ドロップ
concept: Suika-like: drop fruits from top (drag to aim, release to drop) into a box; circle physics; two same fruits merge into bigger next fruit with pop. Fruit chain: cherry, strawberry, grape, orange, apple, pear, peach, pineapple, melon, watermelon. Target: make the melon (level 8) within time => win. Line at top: overflow => lose. Cute faces on fruits.

Grid with arrow tiles pointing in 4 directions. Tap an arrow: it slides in its direction; if blocked by another arrow it bumps back (lose a heart, 3 hearts). Clear all arrows off board to win. Generate solvable board by placing arrows in reverse removal order.

3 rounds: glass shapes differ (tall, wide, curvy). Hold to pour from tap; release to stop; liquid keeps settling briefly (foam for beer-like soda). Score by closeness to line. Win if average error small. Bubbles, foam, drip SFX.

Rotating wooden log (changing speed/direction). Tap to throw knife upward; sticks into log and rotates with it. Hitting an existing knife = clang, knife bounces off, lose. Apples on log give bonus. Stick 8 knives => log shatters into chunks, win.

3D helix tower (mini3d): central pole with ring platforms each with a gap and red danger segments. Ball bounces in place; drag horizontally rotates tower. Ball falls through gaps; passing 3 rings quickly = fireball smashes platform. Touching red = lose. Reach bottom (10 rings) = win with splash.

ja: ブラックホールで街を飲め
hookJa: 街ごと全部いただきます
concept: Top-down angled 3D view of a city grid with low-poly objects (people, benches, cars, trees, houses, skyscraper). Drag to move a black hole disk. Objects smaller than hole fall in (shrink+spin), hole grows. Reach target size (swallow the tower) before time => win.

ja: 髪を伸ばせチャレンジ
concept: 3D runner: girl character runs forward; drag to steer. Collect hair pieces to grow long hair trail behind (segments). Blades/scissors cut hair. At finish, hair length sets a multiplier ladder (x1..x10). Win if length above threshold.

Stacked colored wooden plates pinned by colored screws. Top bar has 3 boxes each wanting 3 screws of a color, plus 5-slot holding tray. Tap visible screw (not covered by an upper plate) to unscrew (spin anim) into matching box or tray. Plates fall when all screws removed. Win clearing all plates; lose if tray overflows.

ja: 極寒サバイバル：炉を守れ
hookJa: 氷点下60℃。街を救えるのはあなただけ。
concept: Whiteout-Survival parody. Circular snowy town around a giant central furnace. Temperature gauge drops as blizzard intensifies. Resources: wood, coal. Tap tree stumps/coal piles around town to send workers (little figures walk & return with resource). Tap the furnace to feed fuel (heat up). Survivors counter; if temp too low people freeze (icy statues) and count drops. Mid-game event 'BLIZZARD!' screen whiteout wind particles. Survive to the end with >=50% people => win. Warm orange glow vs blue snow palette, heavy snow particles.

ja: ドット絵タワーディフェンス
hookJa: 塔を置いて王国を守れ
concept: Pixel art winding path on grass. Coins accumulate. Tap empty build pads to place archer tower (then tap again to upgrade to cannon). Waves of pixel slimes/goblins/boss orc walk the path; towers auto-shoot projectiles. 10 lives at castle. Survive 3 waves => win.

Top-down: your blob army (number) marches up; each stage has two/three paths with operations (+15, x3, -30, ÷2) and enemy troops. Tap a path to route. Soldiers fight at the enemy castle at end; castle has defenders number. Animated tiny soldiers, numbers pop. 4 decisions.

Side view: you are an archer on a castle wall at left. Drag back to aim (trajectory preview dots), release to shoot arrows arcing with gravity. Enemies (knights, ladder carriers, a big ogre) approach from right. Headshot bonus. Wall HP bar. Survive => win.

Last-War parody in 3D perspective: a squad of soldiers auto-fires forward along a road; drag to move left/right. Zombies approach in a horde (low-poly green). Shooting upgrade gates (+fire rate, +soldiers) with HP numbers that go up when shot. Barrels explode. Boss zombie at end. Lose if zombies reach squad.

ja: 勇者タワー吸収バトル
hookJa: 自分より弱い敵だけ倒せ！
concept: Hero Wars tower parody: 2 towers side by side. Hero with power number at left tower's room. Right tower rooms contain monsters with power numbers, some with potions (+) or traps. Drag hero into a room: if hero > enemy, absorb and add; else hero dies. Rescue princess at top. 3 levels of increasing floors.

hookJa: 強欲か、慈悲か。あなた次第。
concept: Pixel throne room. Townsfolk petitions appear as pixel characters with an icon speech bubble (food, gold, war, festival); swipe left (reject) or right (accept) Reigns-style. Four meters (people, gold, army, church) shown as pixel icons; if any hits 0 or max you are overthrown. Survive 8 decisions => win.

hookJa: マップを全部青に染めろ
concept: State.io parody: 8 bases (circles with troop numbers) on a stylized map. Blue = you, red AI, gray neutral. Numbers grow over time. Drag from your base to another to send half troops (dots stream). Capture all red bases => win.

Top-down ocean with animated waves. Your small raft with survivor. Debris (planks, barrels, leaves) float by. Drag from raft and release to throw hook; retracts collecting items; planks expand raft tiles. Shark circles and bites raft tiles; tap shark to spear it away. Build raft to 9 tiles => win.

hookJa: 地上はもうダメだ。掘れ。
concept: Fallout Shelter parody in pixel art cross-section. Tap dirt cells to dig rooms (power, water, food). Dwellers arrive at door; drag dwellers into rooms to produce. Resource bars drain; radroach invasion event: tap roaches. Keep all bars above 0 until end => win.

Side view. Drag back on catapult arm to set angle & power, release. Boulder flies, hits enemy castle made of blocks (simple rigid body boxes toppling or blocks break with debris). Enemy king on top; knock him down within 4 shots => win. Wind flag indicator.

Neon dome colony. Three dials: O2, Power, Food; each drains at varying rates; tap module buttons to boost one (boost costs other). Meteors fall: tap them to shoot down with laser before hitting domes. Survive => win if colonists >= 60.

ja: 砲台合体ディフェンス
hookJa: 砲台を合体して侵攻を止めろ
concept: Bottom 3x4 grid of turrets; buy button adds level-1 turret. Drag same-level turrets together to merge into bigger gun (visual escalation: pistol, rifle, cannon, laser, mega rail). Enemies march down lanes; turrets auto shoot. Survive until end => win.

ja: カードでタワーバトル
concept: Clash Royale parody vertical arena with river, two lanes, towers. 4 cards (knight, archers, giant, fireball) with elixir costs; elixir bar fills. Drag card to your half to deploy units; they auto walk & fight. Enemy AI deploys too. Destroy enemy king tower (or more crowns by time) => win.

hookEn: The flood is coming! Who gets on?
hookJa: 洪水が来る！誰を乗せる？
concept: Rising water side view; animals (pairs) approach dock with weights; boat has weight capacity & balance (tilts). Tap animals to board; load heavy ones in the middle. Water rises; depart before flooding. Boat must not tip. Save >= 6 animals => win.

ja: ラーメン屋の昼ピーク
hookEn: Can you handle the lunch rush?
hookJa: 昼ピークをさばけるか？
concept: Counter view. Customers arrive with order bubbles (broth type: shoyu/miso/tonkotsu + toppings egg/chashu/nori). Tap bowl -> broth -> noodles (boil timer) -> toppings, then drag to customer. Patience meters. Earn coins; 5 served => win. Steam, slurp SFX.

Items slide on belt; drag each item over scanner laser (barcode side matters: rotate by tap?). Keep simple: drag items across scanner; then choose correct change coins from tray to reach displayed change amount. Queue of 4 customers. Beep SFX, register ka-ching.

Order ticket shows stack (bun, patty, cheese, lettuce, tomato, bun). Ingredients fall from top; move bottom bun plate left/right to catch; wrong ingredient = mess penalty; stack wobbles physics-lite. Complete 2 orders => win.

Idle Miner Tycoon: cross-section with 3 mine shafts, elevator, warehouse. Miners walk and pick ore automatically; tap upgrade buttons (costs, levels) to multiply output; hire manager to auto. Money counter grows exponentially with suffixes (K, M, B). Reach 1B in time => win. Coins fly UI.

hookEn: Barista test: draw a perfect heart
hookJa: バリスタ試験：完璧なハートを
concept: Top view cup of espresso; target pattern (heart / leaf / bear) faintly shown. Drag to pour milk: white foam blobs drawn along path with flow. Score = overlap with target mask vs spill outside. Result shows customer reaction.

Hotel cross-section building with rooms (colored doors/types: single, family, VIP). Guests appear at lobby with icon of wanted room; drag guest to matching free room; rooms become dirty after checkout; tap to clean (maid sparkle). Patience. Score >= target => win.
Top-down lot with spots. Cars queue at gate; drag from car to a spot to draw path; car drives there. Collisions = crash. Cars leave after timer paying coins. Earn target => win.

Conveyor belt loops across screen with various sushi plates (salmon, tuna, egg, shrimp, uni gold plate). Customers seated show desired sushi. Tap plate on belt to grab and deliver to requesting customer automatically; wrong = angry. Serve 6 => win.

Pixel isometric-ish grid park. Guests (pixel people) walk paths with mood icons. Build menu: ferris wheel, coaster, food stand, restroom (costs). Tap grid to place; guests use rides, pay; happiness meter. Reach happiness & money target => win. Rides animate.

hookJa: 育てて、収穫して、繰り返す
concept: Pixel 4x3 farm plots. Tap empty plot to plant (seed), tap to water (droplet), crops grow through pixel stages; tap ripe to harvest (+coins pop); crows land on plots, tap to scare. Harvest 12 crops => win.

hookJa: 子供4人、ピザ1枚。ケンカ厳禁。
concept: Top view pizza with toppings. Swipe straight lines across to cut. After 2 cuts, pieces separate slightly; compute area of each piece (polygon clipping approximate by sampling grid). Judge fairness: kids faces react. Win if max/min ratio below threshold.

ja: 救急外来てんてこまい
concept: Hospital lobby: patients arrive with symptom icon (broken bone, fever, tooth, heart). Drag to matching department room (X-ray, clinic, dental, cardio). Treatment progress bar; cured patient leaves dancing. Waiting patients turn green-sick; if 3 pass out lose. Cure 8 => win.

Day cycle in 4 fast days. Weather forecast icon shown (sunny/cloudy/rain/heatwave). Adjust price slider and ice (tap +/-) before day starts; then watch customers walk by and buy based on price/weather; coins stack. Reach $ target => win. Upgrades stand visual each day.

ja: コインランドリー大混乱
hookJa: 白い服をピンクにするな
concept: Clothes fall from basket onto table (shirts, socks, jeans in whites/colors/darks). Drag each to correct machine (WHITE, COLOR, DARK icons with color). Wrong: machine foams pink. Machines spin anim. Sort 12 correctly => win.

ja: フードデリバリー大作戦
concept: Top-down mini city map; scooter at restaurant; order pins pop up with timers. Tap destination; scooter drives along streets (grid pathfinding) to pick-up/drop; traffic lights. Deliver 5 before timers expire => win. Star ratings pop.

Party race: 4 characters (you + 3 CPU in different colors) on side-scroll track lanes. Mash tap to run; CPU speeds vary with rubber banding. Dust clouds, sweat drops, cheering crowd. Finish first => win (podium).
Big stopwatch counting up; after 3s the digits fade out (hidden). Tap to stop. 4 players: CPU results shown too. Closest to 10.00 wins; big reveal drumroll. Win if you are closest (or within 0.15s).

Sunset silhouette duel: two samurai; random delay (with fakeout signals like birds, leaves) then a big '!' appears. Tap after '!' faster than CPU (reaction ~350ms decreasing each round). Early tap = foul. Best of 3. Flash slash effect, enemy falls.

hookEn: Don't be holding it at BOOM
hookJa: ドカンの瞬間に持つな
concept: 4 characters in circle, bomb with fuse sparkles. When bomb is with you, a prompt arrow shows which direction button to press (random left/right/up) - press matching on-screen button to pass. CPUs pass after random delay. Fuse speeds up; explosion with soot faces. Survive => win.

Each player pumps a balloon; you tap to pump; balloon grows, wobbles, pitch rises; hidden random burst size. Press BANK button to stop. CPUs also pump; biggest unpopped wins. Pop = confetti of rubber, face covered.

Your team of 3 blobs vs CPU team over a mud pit. Rhythm: a marker slides on a bar; tap when it's in green zone for strong pull, mash otherwise weak. Rope center flag moves. Pull enemies into mud => win.
Simon-style 4 neon pads with tones. Sequence plays (3,4,5 long); repeat by tapping. Each pad glow + note. Complete 3 rounds => win. Mistake buzz => lose.

Farm yard: chicks run across in bursts left->right and right->left, some hop into a barn and some come out, plus decoy ducks (don't count). Then answer by tapping one of 4 numbers. Correct => win. Chicks are cute animated shapes.

Mario Party parody mini board (loop of 16 spaces: blue +3 coins, red -3, event ?, star space moves). 4 players take turns (CPU auto). Tap dice block to hit (dice spins). Move piece hopping with sound. Buy star for 10 coins when passing. 3 rounds each. After rounds show ranking; you win if first in stars then coins. Bouncy characters, dice block with numbers.

hookJa: 音楽が止まったら…座れ！
concept: Circle of chairs, 4 players walking around. Music (bgm) plays; it stops randomly (the host must pause music: just show notes stop + big 'STOP'). Tap the nearest free chair quickly; CPUs dash too. Early tap before stop = penalty. 3 rounds eliminate; last one sitting wins.

hookEn: Keep your eyes on the blue token
hookJa: 青いチップから目を離すな
concept: Visual tracking game with 3 cups and a blue token hidden under one. Cups shuffle in arcs with increasing speed across 8 swaps. Tap a cup to reveal the token; finding it clears the challenge with a star celebration.

hookEn: Last one on the ring WINS
hookJa: 最後まで残った者が勝ち
concept: 3D circular arena platform floating (mini3d). 4 bumper balls (low-poly spheres/cars). Drag direction to accelerate (virtual joystick). Elastic collisions. CPUs target nearest. Fall off edge = out. Last standing => win. Platform shrinks later.

3D hex tile floor 2 layers. Your character + 3 CPUs; tiles you stand on shake and fall after 0.5s. Joystick movement. Falling through top layer to lower layer; falling from lower = out. Survive longest => win.
Coins, gems and bombs fall; you and 3 CPUs run on ground (you drag left/right). Collect more than all CPUs. Bombs stun. Gold bars = 10. Score bars displayed. Win if top.

hookEn: One of these buttons is a PIE
concept: 4 contestants with faces in front of pie cannons; 8 buttons on table; each turn a player presses one; one random button fires pie into presser's face. You choose on your turn (tap a button), CPUs choose automatically. Last clean face wins; if you get pied => lose. Suspense drumroll.

WarioWare classic: giant cartoon nose at center-ish moving slightly; a finger at bottom moves left/right automatically; tap to thrust finger up into the nostril. Hit => booger comedic success; miss => finger pokes cheek. 5 seconds.

Mosquito flies in erratic curve over a sleeping person's face/wall. Tap on it to slap with hand (big palm appears). Hit => splat, win. Miss slaps own face with red handprint. 2 mosquitoes on higher speed.
Phone slips from hand and tumbles down; drag hands left/right at bottom to catch. Bounces off obstacles. Catch => phone shows heart; miss => cracked screen spiderweb.

hookJa: 誰かに気づかれる前に…
concept: Close-up jeans zipper; drag the zipper pull upward along the track to the top. Zipper teeth close as you drag. Must reach top in time. People's eyes peeking in corner.
Frying pan with pancake; swipe up to flip; pancake rotates in air; tap/move pan left-right to catch under it. Landed face with golden side up => win; lands on floor/dog eats => lose.
Needle with eye moving up/down slowly (hand tremble). Thread tip moves horizontally toward needle automatically; you control vertical position by dragging. Pass through eye => win sparkle.
Man's face with stubble dots & foam. Drag razor over face; removes hair within path; >90% removed => win, face shines. Avoid nose (cut = bandage lose).
Nail into board; hammer swings pendulum left/right over nail; tap when hammer aligned to strike; each good hit drives nail deeper (3 needed). Mistimed hits thumb (swollen red thumb lose).
Wilted flower in pot; hold to tilt watering can and pour; moisture gauge; the flower blooms when in green zone at time end; overflow drowns flower (sad bubbles).
You are a character at bottom center; dodgeballs thrown from sides/top with telegraph. Swipe/tap left-right lanes to dodge (3 lanes). Survive 5s => win.
Roll cake / baguette slides horizontally; a knife up top; tap to slice at exact half. Show % split; within 45-55% => win; siblings' reaction faces.
Phone with 1% battery; charging plug on a cable; drag plug into moving outlet (orientation matters? keep: outlet slides). Success lightning bolt battery filling; failure phone dies screen black.
Person about to sneeze with building-up ah-ahh faces (fake-outs). Tap to cover with elbow exactly when the ACHOO comes (window). Early cover gets cancelled; late => spray on the cake. Timing micro.
Bubble wrap grid 5x6. Tap/swipe bubbles to pop (flatten with tiny puff, pop pitch varies). Pop all within time => win.
Sleeping person under blanket; alarm clock ringing jumps around the bed; mash tap on clock to stop it; each tap lifts the eyelids more; open eyes fully => win (jumps out of bed).

hookJa: 100人に1人しか見つけられない
concept: Grid of 6x6 identical icons (e.g., cat faces), one slightly different (rotated ear, color shade). Tap it. Random icon theme from 4 drawn shapes.

hookJa: 歯医者さんも推奨の広告
concept: Open mouth with teeth; brown germ monsters on teeth. Scrub by dragging back and forth over them; each germ has HP; foam bubbles. Clean all => sparkling smile.

hookJa: 会社員シミュレーター
concept: Documents slide past quickly; some have green check mark icon (approve) some have red skull icon (reject). Tap to stamp approved ones only (red hanko mark). Stamping wrong = boss angry.

Side view platform; mash tap to run toward train doors which are closing (door progress). Hop over a suitcase obstacle by swipe up? keep: tap mash + one jump prompt. Make it => doors close behind you.
Drag fish from plate to the cat's mouth; cat walks around; a dog tries to intercept; drop onto cat => happy purr hearts.

ja: スーパードットブラザーズ
concept: Pixel side-scroller (auto-scroll right, 1-screen width camera). Plumber-like pixel hero (original design: cap + mustache but distinct colors). Tap to jump (hold for higher). Mushroom-like enemies walk; stomp them for points; ? blocks give coins; pits. Reach flagpole => win with fanfare. 16px sprites scaled 3x.

ja: インベーダーパニック
hookEn: They came from the ad banner
hookJa: 奴らはバナーからやって来た
concept: Space-invaders pixel: 5x8 grid of aliens stepping side to side and down, shooting. Drag ship horizontally; auto-fire? tap to fire. Shields that erode pixel by pixel. UFO bonus. Clear all => win. CRT scanlines.
Pixel breakout: rainbow brick rows, paddle drag, ball bounces with angle by hit position, power-up capsules (multiball, wide). Clear all bricks (small level) => win; lose 2 balls => lose.
Nokia-style green LCD pixel snake on grid; swipe to turn; eat apples to grow; reach length 12 => win; hitting self/wall = lose. LCD palette with ghosting.

hookJa: やせいの こうこくが あらわれた！
concept: JRPG turn-based pixel battle: first-person enemy (slime king) with HP; party of 3 pixel heroes with HP/MP. Command menu icons: Attack, Magic(fire), Defend, Item. Enemy attacks with screen shake/flash. Damage numbers in pixel font. Defeat boss => win fanfare & level up.
Pixel pinball table with bumpers (score & light), slingshots, flippers (tap left half/right half). Ball physics with gravity. Score target reached => win; drain 2 balls => lose.

Vertical shmup: tiny pixel ship follows drag (relative), auto-fires. Boss pixel art at top unleashes danmaku patterns (spirals, rings, aimed). Graze sparks. Defeat boss (HP bar) or survive => win. 3 hits lose.

hookJa: 伝説の魚が待っている
concept: Pixel lake cross-section with fish shadows. Tap to cast; bobber; when it dips ('!') tap to hook; then tension minigame: hold to reel, release to ease; tension bar must stay in range while fish pulls. Catch 2 fish (one big) => win.

hookJa: カエルはなぜ渡るのか
concept: Frogger pixel: road lanes with cars/trucks, river lanes with logs/turtles. Swipe/tap to hop up/left/right. Reach a lily pad home 2 times => win. Squash/splash lose.

Pseudo-3D pixel road racer (OutRun/SNES style): horizon, segmented road with curves & hills, rival karts (sprites scale), drag left/right to steer, auto-accelerate; boost pads; finish 1 lap in top 3 => win. Pixelated (draw at low res look).
Pac-like: small maze, dots, 2 ghosts chasing (simple AI), swipe to turn. Power pellet makes ghosts blue & edible. Eat all dots => win.
Tetromino game on 10x16 pixel board partially pre-filled (with a hole column). Controls: tap left/right halves to move, tap piece to rotate, swipe down to hard drop. Clear 3 lines => win with flash.
Two vertical walls; pixel ninja clings; tap to jump to the other wall; obstacles on walls (spikes, birds, shuriken) scroll down. Collect scrolls. Reach height target => win.
Pixel light-gun: ducks fly out of grass in zigzags; tap to shoot (flash); limited shells per wave (3). Hit 6 ducks => win; laughing dog on misses; shooting the dog = funny lose.

Dungeon room with 3 pixel chests per round; subtle tells (one chest breathes, lid twitch, drool drop). Choose one to open; treasure gold burst or mimic chomp (lose a heart of 2). 4 rounds collect treasure => win.

hookJa: ストライク以外は認めない
concept: 3D lane perspective (mini3d): ball at bottom, 10 pins at far end. Swipe up with direction/curve to roll; ball travels; pins as low-poly cylinders topple with simple physics (impulse, rotation). 2 frames; knock >= 15 total => win. STRIKE big text.
3D hoop with backboard; flick up to shoot basketball in arc (3D projectile). Hoop moves side to side after 3 baskets. Rim bounce physics approx. Make 5 => win. Swish net animation.

hookEn: Guide the marble to the goal
concept: 3D wooden board maze with walls, holes. Drag (virtual tilt) tilts board visually; marble rolls with physics; avoid holes; reach goal flag. Shadows.
3D chase camera behind a small plane flying forward over low-poly terrain & clouds; drag to steer up/down/left/right; rings to fly through (+time, combo). Hit 8 rings => win.

hookJa: シンセウェイブ。速度。ブレーキなし。
concept: 3D synthwave: magenta grid road, sunset sun with stripes, neon palm trees. Player car (low-poly) lane-switch via swipe/drag; traffic cars; nitro pickups; speed increases. Distance goal => win; crash => lose with glitch.

hookEn: Find the exit before HE finds you
hookJa: 奴に見つかる前に出口へ
concept: Wolfenstein-style raycaster first-person maze (textures procedural bricks). On-screen controls: drag to turn/move (left half move, right half turn) or arrow buttons. Find key then exit door. A ghost wanders and approaches (billboard sprite); touching = jump scare lose. Minimap in corner.

hookJa: タイミングよく離して合計7を狙え！
concept: Two 3D dice on a neutral tabletop. Hold to cycle the dice and release at the right moment to target a total of 7. Three throws; hit the target once to clear. Tumbling dice, bouncing motion and celebratory effects.
3D grid floor; a cube with paint rolls one tile per swipe (roll animation around edge); painted tiles color; walls block. Paint all tiles => win.
3D icy slope going downhill; penguin on belly; drag to steer; fish to collect; ice rocks and seals obstacles; jumps. Reach bottom with >=10 fish => win.
3D paper plane gliding through low-poly city streets between buildings; drag to steer; wind vents lift; losing altitude slowly; collect stars; distance goal => win; crash into building = crumple.
3D tunnel (ring segments) spinning towards camera; ship at bottom; drag rotates around tunnel circumference; obstacles (blocks) on tunnel wall; speed up. Survive => win.

3D voxel tower of cubes; a crane wrecking ball swings; drag to pull ball back and release to swing into tower; cubes fly with physics-lite (velocity, gravity, ground bounce). Knock >= 80% cubes off platform => win.

hookJa: ホールインワン？簡単…だよね？
concept: 3D mini golf course (windmill obstacle rotating, walls, slopes). Drag back from ball to aim/power (arrow), release. Ball rolls with friction, bounces off walls. Sink in <=3 strokes => win.

Gacha parody with maximum dopamine: giant capsule machine; tap lever handle to turn (drag in circle). 10 capsules pop out one after another with color hints (silver, gold, RAINBOW). Tap each to open: character card reveal with rarity stars, rainbow beams, screen shake, 'SSR!!!' calligraphy. Rigged to give at least one SSR (win). Ends with collection lineup.

hookEn: Stop on the circles for 100 points each!
concept: Three neon pattern strips display circles, triangles, squares, crosses and stars. Start the strips with the handle or buttons, then tap each STOP button to stop on a target circle. Each accurate stop adds 100 points across three rounds. Flashing lights and colorful celebrations.

hookJa: 削って星を3つ見つけよう！
concept: Scratch-art card with 6 covered areas. Drag to scratch off the silver coating with dust particles and uncover the hidden shapes. Find 3 stars to complete the picture.

Card pack (foil shimmer). Swipe across top edge to tear (tear animation). Cards slide out; swipe to flip through 5 cards; last card glows; holo card with rainbow sheen parallax following finger, sparkle, 'MARKET VALUE ¥1,000,000!?' number roller. Always rare at end (win).
Loot box shakes; mash tap to open (glows, light rays escalate by rarity color common->legendary). Items fly out. Multiple boxes in a row, each faster. Get a Legendary within time => win.

hookEn: Time your release and aim for 100 points!
hookJa: タイミングよく離して100点を狙え！
concept: Colorful timing wheel with point segments. Hold to spin and release at the right moment to aim for 20, 50 or 100 points; a miss adds 0. Points accumulate across attempts, with ticking flapper animation and bright celebration effects.

ja: ネオンボールドロップ
hookEn: Drop 10 balls. Aim for the 80-point pocket!
hookJa: ボールは10個。80点ポケットを狙え！
concept: Neon peg board with 10 balls. Tap a position at the top to drop a ball; it bounces between pegs into pockets worth 10, 20, 30 or 80 points. Accumulate points toward the target. Lights flash for high-scoring drops.

hookEn: The claw is weak on purpose
concept: Glass cabinet with plush toys piled. Hold right button to move claw right, release; hold down/back? Simplify 2-step: hold to move horizontally, release; then tap to drop. Claw closes, lifts toy (may slip based on grip position). Deliver to chute => win. 3 tries.

hookEn: Push the discs over the edge!
hookJa: ディスクを押して端から落とせ！
concept: Arcade disc pusher with a shelf moving back and forth and colorful discs near the edge. Tap to place discs, up to 32 attempts. Each disc pushed over the front edge adds score; aim to reach the point target.

hookEn: Log in EVERY day. Or else.
hookJa: 毎日ログインしてね（圧）
concept: Calendar of 7 days with gifts; tap today's gift to open (chest open, gems explode, counter rolls up). Then bonus mini: spin flashy wheel to multiply. Streak fire animation. Trap: 'Day 7 reward: another login bonus'. Always win; stars from multiplier.

Hero walks up a path choosing between 2 doors each floor with math (+5, x2, -10, x3) and monsters with levels (fight if higher). Hero level number grows with glow. At the top, Demon Lord Lv.999; if hero level > 999 => epic slash win. 5 choices.

hookEn: Evolve into a GOD in 20 seconds
concept: Evolution chain: cell -> fish -> frog -> monkey -> human -> robot -> planet -> galaxy. Tap food/DNA orbs floating around to feed; evolution meter fills; evolution flash, new form morphs with transform animation and cosmic zoom-outs. Reach galaxy => win.
Grid 4x4 anvil board; tap chest to spawn level-1 daggers; drag same-level swords together to merge (sparks, hammer clang) up to level 8 legendary flaming sword. Reach level 7 => win.

Clicker: monsters appear with HP; tap to attack (damage numbers pop). Coins drop; upgrade buttons (sword dmg, hire hero DPS) with exponential costs; 5 stages then boss titan with timer. Defeat titan => win. Numbers with suffixes.

Tamagotchi-like egg device frame (pixel LCD inside?) using vector device. Pet has needs icons (hunger, fun, clean). Buttons: feed, play, clean; poop appears. Keep needs up; pet evolves twice into cute (or ugly if neglected) form. Cute final => win.

Vampire-survivors/Survivor.io: top-down field; joystick drag moves hero; auto-weapons (magic bolts nearest, orbiting books). Enemies swarm from edges; XP gems; level-up pauses with choose 1 of 3 upgrades (cards). Massive numbers of enemies (efficient drawing). Survive 25s => win with boss killed.

ja: 回転する剣で成り上がれ
concept: io-game: your hero has swords orbiting; move by drag; pick up sword items to add blades; enemy heroes with blades too; blade clashes spark; eliminate enemies by hitting their body with blades. Kill 3 => win.
Field where slimes bounce around; drag one onto same-type to merge into bigger slime (with crown on king). Different colors. Merge up to King Slime (level 5) => win.

Cauldron; recipe card shows target color (mix of R/Y/B). Tap ingredient bottles to add color drops; stir by circular drag; liquid color blends (additive/subtractive approx). When close to target, press BREW; potion bottle emerges. 3 recipes => win. Explosion if too far.

Egg in nest; temperature gauge; rub the egg (drag back and forth) to warm; too hot = burn; it cools over time; cracks grow when in ideal zone; final hatch: baby dragon pops, sneezes fire. Rarity reveal of dragon color (rainbow if perfect).

hookJa: スウィート！デリシャス！
concept: 7x7 match-3 board with candies; swipe to swap; matches clear with sparkles, cascades, 4-match striped, 5-match color bomb. Objective: score target or clear 20 red candies. Cascading combo voice text ('Sweet!','Divine!') via shared words.

3x3 sliding puzzle with picture (procedurally drawn cute scene split into tiles, number corner). Tap tile adjacent to gap to slide. Shuffle limited (8-12 random moves) for solvability. Solve => win, picture completes with shine.

hookJa: 天才の目だけが見抜く
concept: Two stacked procedural scenes (house, sun, tree, cat, car) with 3 differences (color change, missing item, size). Tap difference areas on either image to circle. Misclick penalty time. Find all 3 => win.

Viral math picture puzzles: e.g., apples+apples=10, apple+banana=8, banana+clock=? using drawn icons (numbers only). Choose among 4 answers. 3 questions with twist (clock hands different). Includes classic '6÷2(1+2)' joke answer choose. Get 2 correct => win.
5x5 grid of pipe pieces randomly rotated; tap to rotate 90° with click; water source to sink; when connected path complete, water flows animation filling pipes, flower blooms. Win.
8x8 grid; 3 random polyomino pieces at bottom; drag onto grid; completing rows/cols clears with blast & combo multipliers. Score target => win; no moves => lose.

hookEn: Prove you're not a robot. Again.
hookJa: ロボットじゃないと証明せよ（再）
concept: Parody captcha 3x3 grid with drawn pictures (traffic lights, buses, bikes, cats); instruction via icon at top (select all with [icon]). Tap tiles, VERIFY. Round 2 tiles fade and new ones appear. Round 3 absurd: 'select all squares with a robot' and one tile shows a mirror reflection of you as a robot (joke). Pass 3 => win 'You are human. Probably.'

hookJa: 倉庫が君を待っている
concept: Pixel sokoban with 2 small levels; swipe/arrow buttons to move worker; push crates onto goal markers; undo button. Solve => win.

hookEn: The World Cup is on YOU
hookJa: ワールドカップはキミにかかっている
concept: Behind-kicker view of goal with keeper. Swipe to shoot (direction+curve+power). Keeper dives based on AI guess. 5 kicks alternate with you saving (tap left/center/right for keeper dive). Win shootout. Crowd roar.

Batter's view: pitcher throws (fastball, curve, change-up). Tap to swing at the right timing; hit quality determines distance; ball flies into stands with camera following; distance meters. 3 HR out of 8 pitches => win.
Target at distance; bow aim with drag; sway (breath) circles; wind arrow indicator; release to shoot; arrow flight with drop & drift; score rings 1-10. 3 arrows total >= 24 => win.

Side view dohyo; two rikishi. Tachiai timing tap at the right moment (gauge) for advantage; then alternate-direction mash (left/right buttons) to push; opponent counters randomly (tap prompt to resist). Push out => win.
3D downhill slope with red/blue gate flags; skier (low-poly) carves with drag; snow spray particles; trees; pass gates alternately; miss 2 gates => lose; finish => win with time.

Behind-player view vs big opponent boxer. Opponent telegraphs punches (glint, wind-up); swipe left/right to dodge; tap left/right to punch when open (after dodge = counter damage). Opponent HP bar; KO => win with stars circling.
Dirty room top-down (stains, dust, trash). Tools: sponge (scrub stain by rubbing), vacuum (drag over dust), grab trash to bin. Cleanliness %; 95% => sparkle before/after. Satisfying swish SFX.

ja: 大変身メイクオーバー
concept: Character face with messy hair, pimples, tired eyes. Sequence of steps with tools: tap pimple patches, drag mask over face, choose hairstyle (3 choices), lipstick color, accessory. Before/after split screen reveal with sparkles & crowd 'wow'. Style score shown; always win if completed.
Muddy car/side of house with dirt mask layer; drag water jet (spray particles) to erase dirt revealing clean shiny paint; % meter; 90% => win, shine glint.

Colorful layered soap block; swipe down to slice thin sheets which curl and fall as cubes/shavings with crunchy SFX; pattern revealed on cross-section. Cut 12 slices => win. Satisfying pastel palette.

Fake loading bar stuck at 99%. Mini tasks to push it: tap 'Retry', shake (swipe) the bar, drag the last 1% pixel chunk into place, fight a spinning wheel cursor (tap it to stop). Silly messages icons. Hit 100% => win with fireworks and then 'Loading 2/2' joke.
Fake annoying ad popup; multiple X buttons: fake ones spawn more popups; real one is tiny, runs away when finger near, hides behind elements. Popups stack (close them). Close the final real X => win.

ja: ウイルスを検出しました！！！
hookJa: あなたの端末に39個のウイルス！！
concept: Retro OS desktop (pixel, 90s windows) with fake antivirus; viruses are pixel bugs crawling across windows eating icons; tap to zap; progress scan bar; some windows pop up with fake 'Download cleaner' buttons (tapping = more bugs). Clear all bugs => win.

hookJa: おめでとうございます！！！賞品を受け取って！
concept: 90s web banner style flashing prize page: spinning prize (car/phone/cash) bouncing around the screen like the DVD logo, while other 'visitors' (cursor hands) also chase it; tap it before the counter ticks to 1,000,000. Visitor counter increments rapidly. Catch it 3 times => win. Marquee text, starbursts, blink.

hookEn: The final ad. The ad of all ads.
hookJa: 最後の広告。すべての広告の王。
concept: Final boss: The Ad King, a giant crowned billboard monster made of popups. Phase 1: it spawns popup windows that fly at you (tap their X to close). Phase 2: it fires 'INSTALL' buttons like bullets — drag your cursor-ship to dodge while auto-firing. Phase 3: its weak point 'SKIP' button appears — mash it. Epic ending with credits roll of all 150 categories.
